sensor_comparison.role: Long-term historical reference shoreline (x_ref) & seasonal baseline
sensor_comparison.limitation: 30 m pixel mixes wet sand, swash & riprap on narrow (<30 m) Oceanside beaches; 16-day revisit misses storm peaks.

sensor_comparison.role: SWIR-enabled MNDWI radiometric anchor + CDIP 045 wave correction
sensor_comparison.limitation: 10 m pixel (20 m SWIR) cannot resolve <10 m riprap pinch-points; 5-day revisit misses rapid 1–4 day post-storm recovery.

sensor_comparison.role: High-resolution 3 m daily constellation + AROSICS + CDIP 045 + NIR calibration
sensor_comparison.limitation: Requires AROSICS land-masked tie-points (1.86 m mean shift) and low-tide NIR bottom-reflectance calibration.

sensor_comparison.role: In-situ NAVD88 elevation profiles & MHW (1.344 m) ground truth
sensor_comparison.limitation: Labor-intensive field survey; Oct 29, 2023 survey lost RTK lock ('Single Signal all survey').
